limits: Metrics are viewed NQ development, not untouched final4096 or seven-benchmark generalization.

TopK sigmoid scores are ranking outputs; threshold0.5 BA is diagnostic, not calibrated Mixed probability.
Variance threshold0.08 is predeclared; MSE/MAE losses are variance-unit diagnostics, not BCE.

Bootstrap intervals condition on selected models and paired questions, not training-seed uncertainty.
